name: apply a do-style intervention fixing a variable to a point value
definition: set the chosen target variable to a constant (or a point-mass with tiny variance), thereby dropping its incoming dependency edges from the intervened structure.
failure_mode: intervention failing to sever parent structure yields a spurious/extra edge

name: compile a scala project into a jar at an exact path
definition: Build the Scala project with its dependency manager so an assembly JAR is produced at a precisely specified file path.
failure_mode: Build failure or wrong artifact location fails the presence check.

name: create a conda environment from an environment spec file
definition: Use the package manager to instantiate a new named environment from the provided dependency file.
failure_mode: If the environment is never created or not discoverable by name, the check fails.

name: create a python virtual environment at a specified path
definition: instantiate a venv exactly under the project directory so its interpreter exists at the expected path.
failure_mode: venv not created at the expected location fails the existence check
